Agentic checkout has multiple actors. The component shows who acted, what is pending, and where the user still has control.

Event rows are native buttons with a visible focus ring, and each renders both `label` and `state` as text, so checkout ownership does not depend on color. Actor icons are hidden from assistive technology.

doDont.statement: An agent builds a cart, asks for approval, starts payment, and hands off to merchant fulfillment.

items.name: agent-payment-authorization
items.title: AgentPaymentAuthorization

meta.maturityNote: README lists all agentic commerce components as Experimental. docs/agentic-commerce.md marks this family's ScopedSpendControl, ProductFeedReadinessPanel and MachinePaymentMeter as Stable; that table is aspirational and conflicts with the graduation rule in docs/component-readiness.md, which requires the accessible-naming check to pass. docs/agentic-commerce.md currently contains no accessibility guidance. Revisit after Phase 4.

compositionRules.statement: Motion-aware. Accepts ModelessMotionIntensity | undefined.
Requires: agentName, amount, merchant, steps.
Money movement needs visible authorization boundaries. The component makes intent, merchant, amount, risk, and human approval legible before settlement.

The flow diagram carries `role="img"` with an `aria-label`, and each step renders its `label` and `actor` as text. Step rows are native buttons, so they are reachable and operable by keyboard with a visible focus ring, and each exposes its selected state through `aria-pressed`. The list is wrapped in a labelled group. Amount, merchant, and risk score are exposed as text metrics rather than through the diagram.

doDont.statement: An agent wants permission to make a bounded purchase.
